correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md and exact frozen tree including CHECK.py hash and dependencies. The b-sum of modulations annihilates cross-residue terms and gives q times the circulant translate Gram operator on each residue fiber u. A p-point DFT diagonalizes it with eigenvalues q|Σ_t g[u+qt] e^(−2πijt/p)|². For rescaled nonnegative fiber a_t=√q g_u[t], all squared Fourier magnitudes in [1±δ]; Z²=(Σa)^2 and Q=Σa² both lie there. m=max a≥(1−δ)/√(1+δ)≥6/7; 2mr≤Z²−Q≤2δ so residual ℓ1 r≤7δ/6. Then |m−1|<(5/8)δ and sum_{others}a_t²≤(7δ/6)², so squared fiber error <(16/9)δ²; fiber orthogonal sum yields global dist ≤4δ/3 independent p,q. δ=0 forces one unit spike in each fiber and converse holds. A two-tap fiber gives eigenvalues (√(1−t²)±t)², δ=2t√(1−t²), distance∼t, ratio→1/2, ruling out o(delta) only. Independent direct finite frame matrix/DFT comparisons for three nontrivial (p,q) pairs have error<1e-10; finite checks are not proof of all p,q.
